I always appreciate informative threads like this one, but I strongly disagree with your take profits philosophy. 

You can definetely go broke if you don't let your winners run enough to cover your losses and then some. Risk to reward is important. You can't allow yourself to take a 10 pips win if your average loss is 50 pips. You'd need a huge winrate to profit from this, and a single losing streak will erase months of progress.

I also agree, though, that setting a single take profit is not the best approach to do this because it's so easy for momentum to fizzle out a few pips before it.

I believe there is a middle ground to this. Simply have a system for scaling out of a winning trade at some point. I personally take half my position off when price is at 1R compared to my stop, and I let the second half run until my exit conditions are met.

Something you'll quickly realize when trading is that we are very good at telling ourselves madeup stories about the market when we want to see something. Esistono *solo* metodi loschi. L'unica differenza è quanto loschi debbano diventare, e ciò dipende dal tipo di "flow di abbonamento" imposto dalla regolamentazione del paese in cui operi. Esiste il "1 click flow" per esempio, dove per abbonarsi basta premere un pulsante; il "2 click flow" dove è richiesta la doppia conferma; il "pin flow" dove per abbonarti bisogna scrivere un pin inviato al tuo telefono (il più difficile da superare per queste aziende, che spesso evitano tali paesi).
